title: Stephen Fry Kinetic Typography - Language
summary: A kinetic typography animation set to Stephen Fry's spoken essay on language. Fry argues against grammar pedantry and for the way language evolves, including the verbing of nouns.
why: HN uses it as the go-to short piece against pedantry and for language change, recommended whenever grammar disputes come up.

quote.text: I highly encourage this 6 minute take by Stephen Fry on Language
